name: indian_cobra
description: Indian spectacled cobra (Naja naja): mid-brown #7a5a32, reared with a WIDE spread hood, slightly turned so the pale spectacle mark on the back of the hood shows (off-centre squiggle, never a face), head level facing right, loose ground coils. Clearly smaller than king_cobra_reared. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox x -233..+136, y -465..0.
